en.headline: Observatory outlook: cooler mornings, then a drier work week
en.dek: A northeast monsoon replenishment is due tonight, with showers easing and mornings turning slightly cooler before clearer, drier days later in the week.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said a replenishment of the northeast monsoon would reach the Guangdong coast on Sunday night. It expects the region to turn windier over the next few days, with showers easing and mornings becoming slightly cooler.

Sunday was forecast to stay at 26 to 31 degrees, with sunny periods and a few showers, and more showers and thunderstorms in some areas later. Winds were expected to be east force 3, becoming north force 4 at night and occasionally force 5.

Monday is forecast at 25 to 31 degrees, mainly cloudy with a few showers at first and bright periods during the day. Winds should be north force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 on high ground later. Tuesday is forecast at 24 to 29 degrees, with sunny intervals and a dry day, and north to northeast winds of force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 on high ground at first.

From Wednesday the Observatory expects mainly fine and dry weather, with a low around 24 degrees and a high around 30. Thursday and Friday are forecast fine and dry in the day, at about 25 to 30 degrees and 26 to 31 degrees. Under the dry northeast monsoon, the latter part of the week should be generally fine over Guangdong, with a larger day-night temperature difference inland.
The nine-day forecast was issued at 11:30am on Sunday. No tropical cyclone signal was in force. The Observatory said sea surface temperature at North Point was 27 degrees at 7am.

zh.headline: 天文台展望：本周早上稍涼 後期轉晴乾燥
zh.dek: 東北季候風補充今晚抵達廣東沿岸，未來數日風勢較大、驟雨減少，早上稍涼，本周後期大致天晴乾燥。
body: 香港天文台表示，一股東北季候風補充會在星期日晚上抵達廣東沿岸。該區未來數日風勢較大，驟雨會減少，早上亦會稍涼。
星期日預測氣溫26至31度，間有陽光及幾陣驟雨，稍後部分地區驟雨較多並有雷暴。吹東風3級，晚上轉北風4級，間中5級。
星期一大致多雲，初時有幾陣驟雨，日間有陽光，氣溫25至31度，吹北風4至5級，稍後高地間中6級。星期二有陽光，日間乾燥，氣溫24至29度，吹北至東北風4至5級，初時高地間中6級。
星期三起大致天晴乾燥，最低氣溫約24度，最高約30度。星期四及星期五日間晴朗乾燥，氣溫分別約25至30度及26至31度。受乾燥東北季候風持續影響，本周後期廣東大致天晴，內陸日夜溫差較大。
九天天氣預報於星期日上午11時30分發出。當時沒有熱帶氣旋警告信號。天文台指，北角上午7時海水溫度為27度。
